queue.title: Oil prices stable as world supply remains under pressure
queue.excerpt: Brent crude fell 0.6% to $105.26 per barrel. Oil prices continued to stay elevated as global oil supply remains under pressure without a deal between the U.S. and Iran to end the Iran war.

queue.title: New Long Beach record as volume nears 1M containers
queue.excerpt: The Port of Long Beach moved 997,177 twenty-foot-equivalent units in September, its busiest month in 115 years and a 25% increase from September 2025, port officials said Thursday. The total surpassed the port’s previous monthly record of 987,191 TEUs, set in October 2024.

queue.title: FedEx, UPS delivery prices set for record-high Q4: TD Cowen/AFS
queue.excerpt: Easing fuel prices and a rebound in discounting activity offered shippers relief in Q3, but peak season surcharges will turn up the heat.

queue.title: Dyed diesel relief leaves carriers with state-by-state rules
queue.excerpt: Governors across the country are temporarily easing dyed diesel restrictions and suspending fuel taxes as diesel prices remain elevated over year-ago levels.

queue.title: Carrier Logistics, LSP44 announce partnership to automate LTL shipment identification
queue.excerpt: Carrier Logistics and LSP44 have partnered to develop an AI-powered API that can identify less-than-truckload shipments when a shipper or third-party logistics provider does not have the correct tracking number, targeting a source of manual work for carrier customer service teams.

queue.title: Oregon makes changes to simplify weight/mile tax collection
queue.excerpt: Oregon is making some changes to how they collect weight/mile tax from truckers. The state DOT says it will make it easier on everyone.

queue.title: IRS weighs in on red-dye diesel tax relief
queue.excerpt: The IRS has weighed in to clarify further what it will mean if truckers use red-dyed diesel for on-highway use as allowed by an Oct. 6 executive order.
